# petclinic-sdk@1.2.0

A TypeScript SDK client for the 127.0.0.1 API.

## Usage

First, install the SDK from npm.

```bash
npm install petclinic-sdk --save
```

Next, try it out.


```ts
import {
  Configuration,
  AdminApi,
} from 'petclinic-sdk';
import type { DeletePetRequest } from 'petclinic-sdk';

async function example() {
  console.log("🚀 Testing petclinic-sdk SDK...");
  const config = new Configuration({ 
    // To configure HTTP basic authorization: adminBasic
    username: "YOUR USERNAME",
    password: "YOUR PASSWORD",
  });
  const api = new AdminApi(config);

  const body = {
    // number | Identifier of the pet
    petId: 1,
  } satisfies DeletePetRequest;

  try {
    const data = await api.deletePet(body);
    console.log(data);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
  }
}

// Run the test
example().catch(console.error);
```
